text:
Alex: Quick sync — planning a staggered cutover for /classify (v1 -> v2) starting Mon. Need confirmation: which SDK release will include the header fallback, and who owns the runtime routing fallback if the v2 model is scaled down?
Sara: @Alex I can own the SDK patch release (small semver bump). timeline: branch cut today, RC tomorrow, publish Wed.
Jin: I can own runtime fallback routing config. Will add a canary slice and an automatic downgrade policy.
Michael: Re: downgrade policy, please ensure the header negotiation still supports clients using the old header name. We should avoid 500s.
Alex: SG. SDK patch needs to add header alias support. Example config we expect consumers to use:
```yaml
feature_flags:
  enable_v2: true
  header_aliases:
    - X-Redwood-V2
    - X-Use-New-API
```
Sara: Adding alias support now. Will include tests and a migration note in CHANGELOG.
Sara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 — cc @Jin @Michael. Needs an approval for the serialization tweak.
Jin: Reviewing now. Quick note: runtime will need an env flag to enable the soft-fallback window. I'll add `RUNTIME_V2_SOFT_FALLBACK=true` to canary.
Michael: Ops question — who will pick up the client-facing migration email? I can draft it if someone gives me the rollout timeline.
Alex: Draft would be great. Timeline: canary Wed-Thu in region us-west-2 (slice 3), expand Fri if metrics look good, global next Tue.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: slice=3, region=us-west-2, image=api-service:v2-canary-20231109. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/7789
Jin: Canary health check: 200/200, latency +3ms p95, no errors in header parsing.
Sara: SDK CI green except one flaky serialization test — will push a fix within the hour.
Michael: I'll prepare the migration email draft and ping legal for the compliance blurb.
Alex: Owners summary: SDK release = Sara, runtime fallback + env = Jin, comms draft = Michael. Dependencies: SDK PR approved before Wed RC, runtime env toggles in infra repo (jin to open infra PR).
Jin: Opening infra PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/712 — includes canary flag and a rollback playbook.
Sara: After infra PR merges I will cut RC and tag `sdk-1.4.2-rc1`.
Alex: Two quick asks before we close: 1) @Sara add a short example in the README showing both old and new header usage, 2) @Jin add a small smoke check that asserts header aliasing in the canary run.
Sara: Will do.
Jin: On it.
Alex: Thanks — will reconvene async if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
